summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Perlae Atelier. All 12 pytest backend tests passed (products list/filter/detail/404, orders create/validation, contact valid/invalid, newsletter valid/invalid). Frontend: home hero + 3D canvas render, nav links present, 5 featured product cards on home, Boutique filters (tous=9, bijoux=3) update products-count. Product detail shows name/price, qty-plus increments 1->2, add-to-cart opens drawer with cart-item + cart-count-badge=2. cart-qty-plus and cart-remove work. Checkout link navigates to /panier and full order submission produces order-success with order-id (#244df0b7). Contact form submits with success toast, FAQ trigger-0 expands. /artisane and /a-propos load with images. Newsletter footer form submits. Mobile menu toggle at 390px opens mobile-menu with all links.

minor.issue: Task spec expected 7 featured products but seed_data has 6 featured (products 1-5, 7, 9). Not a bug — test spec mismatch. Test asserts >=5.

critical_code_review_comments: seed_data has only 6 featured products; problem statement mentions 7 — verify intended count.

CartDrawer Link uses onClick={() => setOpen(false)} plus <Link>; when tested with playwright force=True the SPA navigation is skipped (works fine for real users clicking). Not a bug but worth noting for testers.
THREE.Clock deprecation warning in console — cosmetic, consider upgrading to THREE.Timer.
Lenis warning: 'container has a non-static position' — recommends adding position:relative to scroll container.
Backend CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Consider restricting origins.
seed_data_creation: None — backend auto-seeds 9 products on startup; TEST_ prefixed orders/contact/newsletter created during runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. For frontend Playwright, prefer normal click (not force=True) on React Router <Link> elements like cart-drawer-checkout-link — force=True bypasses SPA nav.
